mentions.name: Cooperation Cube
mentions.description: Digital version of a physical board game in which 4 players draft cards and place colored sticks on the faces of a wooden cube to complete patterns. The cube rotates 90° every 4 actions, so patterns a player is building can become part of another player's board, mixing strategy, memory, and semi-cooperative play. Cooperation cards let two players coordinate for shared bonuses, and the game ends when someone runs out of short sticks.
